title: UthreatBasisLocation

muted.description: `suppressed` is used with RF threats that have been removed by SiteFilter. `type` is used with RF threats that have been muted using threatTypeMute.

affiliation.description: Affiliation of threat. Also known as basic standard identity in MIL-STD-2525C. Extended with falseDetection.

threatId.description: The unique ID of the threat from a system component.

associatedThreatId.description: Used to link controller and drone.

macAddress.description: Physical MAC address of emitter if known, e.g. WiFi emitters. Lowercase string of hex characters (no `:`).

deviceId.description: The unique ID of the system component sending the threat. For composite devices it is either child or parent device ID.

deviceSerialNumber.description: The serial number of the system component sending the threat. For composite devices it is either child or parent device ID.

detectionType.description: The type of the system component sending the threat.

description.description: Information about the threat. E.g. the manufacturer of the drone causing the threat.

x.description: East/west relative to mission center (cartesian coordinate) [m].

y.description: North/south relative to mission center (cartesian coordinate) [m].

cov.description: Covariance parameters. Defines the uncertainty of the location.

xx.description: xx element of the covariance matrix [m^2].

xy.description: xy element of the covariance matrix [m^2].

xz.description: xz element of the covariance matrix [m^2].

yy.description: yy element of the covariance matrix [m^2].

yz.description: yz element of the covariance matrix [m^2].

zz.description: zz element of the covariance matrix [m^2].

rfInfo.description: Collection of RF information of the threat

frequencyBands.description: The current frequency bands of the threat.

possibleBands.description: The possible frequency bands of the threat. This may contain more frequencies than 'frequencyBands' for threats, that are known to use multiple frequency bands.

rfEmitterId.description: Unique ID of the RF source

threatType.description: Threat type ID will be set for RF threats. Can be used in a threatTypeMute request.

dridDetails.description: All drone ID data decoded into a JSON object from Remote ID packets for this threat. Only available when detectionType is `Drone ID` and uthreatSubscribe.dridDetails is set.

rcs.description: RCS (Radar Cross Section) of the threat [dBm²]. Available for radar devices reporting RCS.

classification.description: If the device has classified the threat, this object contains the classification result.

class.description: The threat type as classified by the device. The possible values depend on the device.

probability.description: The device's confidence in the classification. Range 0.0 .. 1.0.

createdTimeStamp.description: UTC time of creation of this uthreat.

updatedTimeStamp.description: UTC time of the last update of this uthreat. For a new threat this will be equal to createdTimeStamp. Stopping a uthreat counts as an update, and will update this time stamp. UthreatBasis time stamps are not updated when stopped.

stoppedTimeStamp.description: UTC time of stop of this uthreat. Only set when threat is stopped. Also see updatedTimeStamp.
